description: Lasya: a motion and simulation studio site (lasya.codesavory.dev), Houdini work, tools and a lab.

color.name: media-ground
color.usage: Behind every render and video tile, in both themes. Renders are graded on black, so the frame never turns white with the page.

color.name: media-ink
color.usage: Titles and captions laid over media, on the bottom scrim. The same in both themes.

color.name: media-ink-muted
color.usage: Technique captions over media, under the title.

color.name: playhead
color.usage: The progress line under the tile you are pointing at, and the seed in the wordmark. One playhead in accent per screen; the rest stay media-ink.

color.name: frame-count
color.usage: The dot-matrix frame counter in the hero. Measures the hero loop, never decorative.

size.name: playhead-weight
size.usage: Height of the playhead line along the bottom edge of a media tile.

size.name: seed-dot
size.usage: Diameter of the accent seed before the LASYA wordmark.

size.name: content-wide
size.usage: Max width of the portfolio grid and hero. Wider than the 1000px marketing width because the work is the content.
